tasks.task: Tear down a landing page and rank the fixes

items.when: When a page gets traffic but few sign-ups, to find where and why visitors leave
When you have the page and screenshots, to rank conversion problems by impact with a score
When you want each problem turned into a test worth running, with its reason
When the page asks for too many choices, to find where layout, defaults or order stop people
When the findings pile up, to sort them into fix now, test and leave alone
When the client wants the failing parts rewritten and re-checked until the page passes
When the list is full of opinions and should start from buyer evidence and clarity

tasks.task: Rewrite the top screen of a page or store

items.when: When the first screen is vague, to get five headlines with a subhead, button and proof
When it is a store's top screen and you want the copy plus a plan to test it
Before settling the rewrite, to build three different top screens in the site's own look and compare them
When a line could sit on any rival's page, to test it and get a true, specific rewrite
When visitors arrive from an ad, to check the new top screen still keeps the ad's promise
When the three top screens are on one sheet, so a fresh reviewer picks the one to ship or test

tasks.task: Check the match between an ad and its page

items.when: When you have the ad and the page, to score the match and rank each mismatch
When the ad speaks to people who know less or more than the page assumes
When the mismatch is large and the page should be rewritten to continue the ad

tasks.task: Audit a product page and list what to change

items.when: When you have the live page, to rank changes to options, proof, buttons and price
When you only have screenshots, to see what blocks shoppers and what to test
When you know what buyers doubt, to tie each page section to real proof
When reviews exist but sit in the wrong place, to choose which proof goes where

tasks.task: Find where the funnel leaks by step, device and source

items.when: When you have funnel numbers and need the full read by device and traffic source
When you have step counts and screenshots, to name the worst step and its fixes
When the data is GA4 exports, to get conversion by channel and page and the worst drop
When you have a raw event log, to get conversion per step and time to convert
When the client asks if their rates are normal, to compare each step and find the leak

tasks.task: Diagnose a sudden drop in conversion rate

items.when: When sales fell, to split the drop into visits, conversion and order value
When two tools disagree on the same number, to find the step where they split
When the client wants the funnel watched each week so the next drop is caught early

tasks.task: Read heatmaps and session recordings

items.when: Before a recording tool is switched on, to see what fires before consent
When you have heatmap and recording notes, to name the friction and a test for each
When you want a guided run from heatmaps and funnel numbers to a verdict on the first fix

tasks.task: Audit the cart and checkout

items.when: When shoppers leave at checkout, to rank fixes for guest checkout, fields and surprise costs
When the leak may be in settings: payment methods, wallets, taxes or shipping rules
When you need abandoned checkouts counted by cart value and hour before you judge
When you have screenshots of the store's pages, to get a ranked list of what to cut

tasks.task: Fix a lead form, signup or booking flow

items.when: When a form loses people, to set fields, error messages and a plan to raise completions
When a long form must stay, to shorten the field list, restage it and script a test
When a software signup has too many steps, to cut fields and clear up the copy
When the goal is a booked call or appointment, to plan times, questions and follow-up
When people make the same mistake on a form, to check cues, feedback and recovery

tasks.task: Review usability and plan a small user test

items.when: When you need a fast expert pass on a page or form, scored, with ranked fixes
When three people and one morning can show what the numbers cannot
When the page may shut out keyboard or screen reader users, to rank the problems
When the team argues over taste and should watch real people try the task

tasks.task: Run on-site surveys and read what buyers say

items.when: When you need two on-site surveys and a tally of the doubts that stop buyers
When survey answers and tickets are in, to find the patterns and the buyers' words
When survey results look too neat, to score how far each answer can be trusted

tasks.task: Plan a conversion research sprint for a new client

items.when: When a new client, a drop or a redesign needs evidence before anyone tests
Before the sprint, to set the order that finds where, what and why
When you need the bar leading sites in the market set for this kind of page
When the whole site is in scope, to rank fixes for conversion, message and speed

tasks.task: Rank test ideas into a backlog

items.when: When findings and ideas must become fix now, test and park
When research is done, to write each idea as a hypothesis ranked by evidence and profit
When a store wants one test at a time ranked, planned, read and followed by the next

tasks.task: Design an A/B test with sample size and run time

items.when: When a ranked item is marked test and the page has enough traffic to run it
Before launch, to fix the hypothesis, main metric, guardrails and sample per version
Before any test, to see how many visitors it needs and whether it is worth running
When the idea bundles several changes and must be cut to one clean change
When you have visits, orders and revenue, to get weeks needed and a readiness score

tasks.task: Plan a check when traffic is too low for an A/B test

items.when: When you suspect the page is too quiet, to show the run time in weeks
When traffic cannot be split, to swap two versions halfway and compare
When a change goes to nearly everyone, to hold a small group back and compare
When numbers will never be enough, to learn from watching a few real people

tasks.task: Read a finished A/B test and make the call

items.when: When a test has ended, to get ship, keep running, stop or rerun with every sum shown
When all you have is counts from the testing tool or store and need a quick call
When you want a second read: split check, ranges and a ship call
When it is a store test with dates, to check it ran long enough and can be trusted
When the same client runs tests often and each lesson should be saved

tasks.task: Check a running test or one with several versions

items.when: When someone wants to stop early, to check the split and say why it is too young
When there are three to five versions, to pick the right test and say if it is real
When traffic looks uneven between versions, to test whether the split is broken

tasks.task: Read a before-and-after change honestly

items.when: When a change went live with no test and someone asks whether it worked
When the offer or tracking changed mid-run, to say what can still be compared
When the client wants a better check next time than comparing two months

tasks.task: Check tracking, events and consent before measuring

items.when: Before any measuring, to list every tag and what it collects before consent by region
When the site serves EU or UK visitors and a testing or recording tool is planned
When events are missing or misnamed, to write the plan of events, names and tags
When sales or leads are not counted right across analytics and ad platforms
When a store's analytics is new or doubted, to find missing settings and events
When ad platforms and analytics report different conversions, to explain each gap

tasks.task: Check page speed and the mobile experience

items.when: When you have a speed report, to get the fixes in ordered batches
Before a sale or launch, to set a speed budget and a pre-sale checklist
When the phone version is the weak one, to score it and rank the breaks

tasks.task: Plan offer, price and order value tests

items.when: When the price itself is in doubt, to pick a price to try and a test you can undo
When order value is the goal, to rank cart and checkout offers by profit added
When offers were tried, to compare profit per visitor, not conversion rate alone

tasks.task: Find trust gaps and place proof where doubt is

items.when: When visitors do not believe the page, to name the doubts and the proof that settles each
When you have reviews and numbers, to decide which to show and where
When the page uses urgency or scarcity, to see which levers are true and which are fake

tasks.task: Plan popups and lead capture that do not annoy

items.when: When the client wants more signups, to set the popup type, timing and words
When it is a store offer, to get desktop and mobile specs, copy and tests
When the popup's one line is flat, to get five headlines to choose from
Before launch, to check the popup does not trick or shame the visitor

always.when: Before you quote a rate, when two reports give different numbers for it
Before a readout goes to the client, to put statistics into plain words

helpers.when: When a fix is a rewrite of a whole page or email, not one screen
When a fix needs a new flow or layout designed, not a list of changes
When the winning change must be built into a Shopify theme or checkout
When a test version needs code, or the testing tool must be installed
When the question is which channel or campaign to trust, not which page
When the why needs real interviews, not surveys and recordings

gaps: No library item reads a test with three to five versions and corrects for the extra comparisons
No library item checks a running test for a broken traffic split or early peeking as its main job
No library item reads a before-and-after change with seasonality and trend allowed for; only the kit prompt does
No library item checks cookie consent banners and what tags fire before consent, by region; only the kit covers it
No library item covers on-site search, filters and category pages as a conversion problem
No library item writes the client report for a research sprint or a quarter of tests
No library item keeps a log of past tests and lessons across clients that is not tied to one store
No library item offers clearly different popup layouts to compare, only different words
No library item covers personalising a page by visitor segment or source and testing it fairly
No tool guides exist for analytics, testing or heatmap tools such as GA4, Hotjar, Clarity or VWO
